rationale: The Latin anchors *redire* and *cum redirent* ("to return / when they were returning") make clear that *agén-gehweorfan* means "to return, go back" — not "to change" in any modern sense. The *agén-* prefix ("again, back") and *gehweorfan* ("to turn, go") together form a compound meaning "to turn back." None of the offered WordNet synsets for "change" capture this directional motion sense of returning; the gloss token "change" here is a mistranslation artifact, and no candidate fits.
